name: contact-management-system
description: Full-stack Contact Management System with React, Express, and SQLite in distinct folders

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
